polls.label: SRF · Johannesburg · July 2026
polls.geography: City of Johannesburg, likely voters (53% turnout model)
polls.caveat: ~500-person metro subsample (±4.4%); single house; its likely-voter screen filters out low-propensity, disproportionately ANC-leaning voters. ANC 18 sits below even the DA's own internal polling.

polls.label: DA internal · Johannesburg · reported Aug 2026
polls.pollster: DA internal polling, reported by Helen Zille via News24
polls.caveat: Party-internal, method undisclosed, only two numbers released — and a party has every incentive to publish its best case.

polls.label: SRF · Johannesburg · Feb–Mar 2026
polls.caveat: ~503-person metro subsample; same house and turnout model as the July wave.

polls.label: Ipsos Khayabus · all metros · Dec 2025–Jan 2026
polls.geography: All-metro aggregate — no Johannesburg-only cut published
polls.caveat: Face-to-face, registered voters, ~43–49% undecided largely unallocated — the methodological opposite of SRF, and the kindest credible read for the ANC. Applies all-metro numbers to Joburg.
